meta.name: diary of a street kid
meta.description:

⚖️ Licença: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/2.5/

What would you do if you were dealt the hand of fate to be a homeless street kid? if there was no way for you to work or live? if all other options were robbed from you and you had nowhere to sleep... nowhere to keep your things... nobody that liked you for you without having some variation of ulterior motive.. if you were all alone on the street without a single person to trust? No place to bathe.. Hungry, you dont want to fall asleep walking down the sidewalk because you have no place to go, so you end up on drugs.. or going home with someone who pays you for sexual acts.. just out of default!! you end up in jail or 6 feet under or on drugs or with people that lie cheat and steal from you and smile and pretend to be your greatest friend.. you cant go back home to your family cuz hey are all gone.. or disoned you.. or maybe you have to steal from a store because you are so uncomfortable with the pain that comes with starving.. could you? how far would you go?? at what cost ?? would you sell out a friend and ruin their whole life if it meant making your own better?? Would they do it to you?? have they already?? the faith of a child and the hopes of a martyr.. the passion of…
